name: Porsche Boxster S 986 (M96 3.2 flat-six, 2003–2004)
source: Porsche 986 maintenance schedule (stuttcars.com, pcarwise.com), with modern M96 practice.

items.name: Engine oil & filter
items.notes: Porsche A40 0W-40/5W-40. Porsche allowed 15k/2 years, but 5k/12 months is best practice for the M96.

items.name: Service inspection (brakes & pipes, tyres, coolant pipes, RMS/oil leaks, radiators for debris)
items.notes: Front radiators trap leaves and rot. MOTs noted corroded brake pipes (2015–16) and an oil leak.

items.name: Drive (auxiliary) belt
items.notes: The M96 has timing chains, not a belt.

items.name: Coolant
items.notes: Porsche says 10 years. After a long lay-up, change it.

items.name: IMS bearing upgrade (if not already done)
items.notes: 2004 3.2s have the single-row IMS bearing, the failure-prone type. Upgrade proactively, ideally with a clutch and RMS. If it's been done, log it.

items.name: Tyre age check
items.notes: Replace tyres over about 6–10 years old whatever the tread. Anything fitted before 2017 is well past it.
